registryBasis: Zhejiang’s official portal identifies this Longgang as the county-level city administered by Wenzhou, consistent with the roster point and distinct from Shenzhen’s Longgang District. Longgang city’s official government site publishes a Natural Resources and Planning Construction Bureau section; a public procurement notice by that bureau is for compiling Longgang real-estate cadastral maps of state-owned construction land, confirming city-specific cadastral work.
